about:
Central Florida Metal Shop, doing business as Central Florida Metals, operates from Orlando, Florida. The company’s website has carried a 2021 copyright notice, indicating it was established by that year; no founders or ownership structure are disclosed in public sources.

The shop specializes in sheet metal fabrication, welding, and duct metal fabrication, producing commercial ductwork ancillary components for HVAC and construction projects. Its capabilities also extend to construction-related services such as general contracting, design-build, pre-construction, pre-fabrication, and 24-hour maintenance, according to its services page. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

The company serves the commercial construction sector, including apartment, villa, and industrial building projects, as well as the broader metal fabrication industry. Its ductwork components are used in HVAC systems for new construction and renovation work.

The firm emphasizes a “Metal Fabrication Done Right!” approach and highlights a three-step philosophy built on people, process, and partnership, with services that extend to design-build, pre-construction, and pre-fabrication support.
